title: Analista de Abastecimento e Compras de Alimentos e Bebidas SR | TFC | São Paulo
description:
Sobre a Empresa

No TFC Food&Market somos responsáveis por aprimorar a experiência dos clientes conectando-os a um estilo ativo e saudável através do universo de alimentos e bebidas e proporcionando um espaço integrado nas lojas com opções para uma alimentação mais saudável e equilibrada, e com produtos selecionados pela nossa curadoria no mini market.

Sobre o Cargo

A TFC Food&Market busca de um profissional qualificado para ocupar a posição de Analista Sênior de Abastecimento e Compras de Alimentos e Bebidas para compor o time. Esse analista responsável pelo abastecimento de alimentos, bebidas e embalagens das lojas visando sempre uma gestão inteligente de estoque e fluxos, considerando perecibilidade e sazonalidade dos itens juntamente com a demanda individual do time e a necessidade de cada loja.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejamento e Controle de Abastecimento;
  • Planejar o fluxo de reposição de Alimentos e Bebidas para todas as lojas, considerando giro, cobertura e prazos de entrega;
  • Assegurar níveis adequados de estoque, prevenindo rupturas e excessos;
  • Controlar pedidos internos, validando quantidades, prazos e acompanhando pendências com logística e fornecedores;
  • Definir estoques mínimos e máximos conforme demanda, sazonalidade e shelf life dos produtos;
  • Atuar como elo entre lojas, centro de distribuição e fornecedores, garantindo disponibilidade e regularidade no abastecimento;
  • Apoiar os gerentes de loja nas previsões de consumo e no planejamento de reposição;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de abastecimento e transferência entre unidades;
  • Executar o abastecimento interestadual e intrapolítico (dentro de São Paulo), conforme calendário e prioridade operacional;
  • Monitorar indicadores de ruptura, cobertura e giro por meio de dashboards de performance;
  • Garantir o cumprimento do Enxoval Padrão em toda a rede.

Qualificações

  • Graduação necessária: Concluída ou Cursando em Logística, Gastronomia, Nutrição, Administração.

Habilidades Necessárias

  • Domínio de conceitos de estoque: cobertura, giro, curva ABC, ponto de reposição e shelf life.
  • Capacidade de planejar e ajustar o fluxo de abastecimento conforme histórico de vendas, demanda e sazonalidade.
  • Conhecimento em processos de transferência e reposição entre lojas e centros de distribuição.
  • Excel intermediário/avançado e experiência com ERP de gestão de estoque e compras. Usamos Ciss.
  • Entendimento de fluxos logísticos, lead time e priorização de entregas, principalmente.
  • Perfil organizado, analítico e proativo, com boa comunicação e foco em resultados operacionais.
  • Autonomia para execução, garantindo alinhamento com as políticas e prazos da área.

Habilidades Preferenciais

  • Organização e disciplina: gerencia múltiplas tarefas e prazos simultâneos.
  • Proatividade e iniciativa: identifica problemas e propõe soluções operacionais.
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa: articula informações entre lojas, estoque e fornecedores.
  • Foco em resultados: mantém disponibilidade de produtos e eficiência do estoque.
  • Atenção a detalhes: evita rupturas, excessos e perdas.
  • Autonomia: toma decisões operacionais dentro das políticas da área.

*Imprescindível ter atuado na área de alimentos e bebidas

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Manager to join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.

Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.

  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.

Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Sr. Desenvolvedor Back-end Java
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Sobre a vaga

O projeto envolve a arquitetura e o desenvolvimento de uma plataforma robusta, sustentada por uma infraestrutura moderna baseada em APIs. Faremos a integração com um parceiro fintech líder de mercado para lidar com a mecânica central de abertura de contas, financiamento e negociações (trading), permitindo que nossa equipe se concentre em construir uma experiência superior voltada ao cliente.

O sucesso exige mais do que apenas um código excelente. Você se juntará a uma equipe dinâmica e multidisciplinar de gerentes de produto, designers de UX/UI, estrategistas de negócios e especialistas em conformidade (compliance). Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração para navegar por regulamentações financeiras complexas, traduzir requisitos de negócios intrincados em soluções técnicas elegantes e resolver problemas desafiadores de integração com nossos parceiros externos. Esta função é ideal para um solucionador de problemas proativo, que prospera em um ambiente colaborativo e é apaixonado por construir produtos que tenham um impacto real no futuro financeiro das pessoas.

Requisitos

  • Inglês B2 ou superior.
  • Forte proficiência em Java, com foco em frameworks modernos — especialmente Spring Boot.

title: Lead Data Platform Architect
description:
Lead Data Platform Architect

Mars is a family-owned business with more than $50 billion in global sales. We produce some of the world’s best-loved brands: M&M’s®, SNICKERS®, TWIX®, MILKY WAY®, DOVE®, PEDIGREE®, ROYAL CANIN®, WHISKAS®, EXTRA®, ORBIT®, 5™, SKITTLES®, BEN’S ORIGINAL®, and COCOAVIA®. Alongside our consumer brands, we proudly take care of half of the world’s pets through our nutrition, health and services businesses such as Banfield Pet Hospitals™, BluePearl®, Linnaeus, AniCura, VCA™ and Pet Partners™. Headquartered in McLean, VA, Mars operates in more than 80 countries. The Mars Five Principles – Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom – inspire our 160,000 Diverse Associates to act daily towards creating the world we want tomorrow.

The Lead Data Platform Architect is instrumental in delivering scalable, repeatable and agile data and platform architectures to unlock and drive business value across Finance, Commercial, R&D, MGS Labs and Innovation:

As the Lead Data Platform Architect in the Enterprise Data & Platform team, your key responsibilities are as follows:

TECHNICAL PROFICIENCY AND LEADERSHIP

  • Lead the definition and execution of data architecture strategies across multiple business domains and data platforms.
  • Drive the development of scalable, integrated data models and architectures across raw, trusted, and harmonized zones.
  • Define and execute the data product strategy for assigned business areas in collaboration with analytics and business teams.
  • Act as a thought leader and trusted advisor, supporting teams in understanding business objectives, data requirements, processes, and enabling technologies.
  • Ensure all data architecture efforts are aligned with the broader business vision and strategic priorities and provide architectural oversight across delivery initiatives.
  • Collaborate with other data architects to ensure consistent and integrated use of data assets across the organization.
  • Identify cross-segment and cross-function data dependencies or issues and lead resolution efforts.
  • Provide strategic guidance on data domains, process analysis, data analysis, and modelling techniques.
  • Mentor and coach solution / data architects and engineers to build internal data architecture capability.
  • Advocate for best practices, tools, and methods related to data architecture.
  • Ensure understanding and compliance of data protection policies, security policies, and GDPR

DELIVERABLE INVOLVEMENT & OWNERSHIP

  • Reference Architectures: Own and maintain reusable architectural patterns
  • High-Level Designs (HLDs): Review and approve HLDs from Solution Architects and 3rd parties
  • Key Design Decisions (KDDs): Own and govern major architectural decisions for alignment with the Architecture Review Board and beyond
  • Architecture Option Assessments: Lead decisioning on tooling, modelling, and patterns

DATA & PLATFORM ARCHITECTURE OWNERSHIP

  • Develop and maintain current and future state data architectures, models, and roadmaps.
  • Promote awareness and understanding of data architectures across the organization.
  • Review and validate high-level models and reference architecture libraries
  • Approve changes to shared or enterprise-wide data models

Knowledge and Experience

ESSENTIAL:

  • Previous experience as a Senior Data or Platform Architect essential
  • Proven experience as a senior data or platform architect, or similar leadership role in data & platform strategy.

title: Indirect Tax Manager

Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;

Language:

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Supervisor (a) De Excelência Operacional - Qualidade
description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento ao Terrorismo | Banco
description:
O Banco Carrefour é a maior Fintail do Brasil e braço financeiro do Grupo Carrefour Brasil, único varejista com banco próprio. Com a missão de melhorar a vida das famílias brasileiras, dando acesso ao crédito e serviços financeiros inovadores, o Banco Carrefour é um dos maiores emissores de cartão de crédito do país, atendendo a milhões de brasileiros.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores e quer embarcar com a gente na missão de melhorar a vida das famílias brasileiras, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

#BancoCarrefour

Sobre a área:

A área de Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento ao Terrorismo (PLD/FT) do Banco Carrefour atua como um pilar estratégico de proteção e sustentabilidade do negócio. Sua missão é garantir a integridade das operações financeiras , assegurando total aderência às normas do Banco Central e órgãos reguladores.

Desafios dessa posição:

Responsável por liderar a frente operacional e tática de Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e Financiamento ao Terrorismo. O foco principal é garantir a sustentação dos processos, viabilizar o lançamento de novos produtos com segurança regulatória, dar suporte e trabalhar em parceria com a área de estratégia e data analytics de PLD/FT e realizar a gestão do time.

Sustentação e Crises: Gestão do ecossistema de sistemas , controle de incidentes críticos e mitigação de riscos operacionais;

Business Enablement: Emissão de pareceres técnicos (AGR) para novos produtos, com foco estratégico em Conta Digital PF e Segmento PJ;

Performance & Data Analytics: Criação e gestão de KPIs operacionais e táticos; transformação de dados em inteligência para reporte executivo;

Eficiência Tática: Colaboração direta com a área de Estratégia de PLD, fornecendo insumos práticos para a melhoria contínua do programa;

Compliance & Auditoria: Interface com Auditorias Internas/Externas, suporte em inspeções e garantia do cumprimento das normas vigentes;

Representação Institucional: Gestão de agendas com associações setoriais e manutenção da governança da área;

Liderança de Pessoas: Coordenação, desenvolvimento e mentoria do time técnico.

Você precisa ter:

Ensino Superior completo em Direito, Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Ciência de Dados ou áreas afins;

Conhecimento em Pacote Office e em ferramentas Google, incluindo GCP;

Profundo conhecimento das normas do BACEN (Res. 3.966, Circ. 3.978) e regulamentações de PLD/FT;

Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI ou SQL);

Capacidade de estruturar Dashboards de performance e interpretar tendências de risco (Data Analytics);

Conhecimento em conta digital PF e PJ;

Experiência com gestão de pessoas;

Inglês avançado e/ou Fluente.

Adoraríamos se você tiver:

Certificações em PLD/FT;

Pós-graduação ou MBA, em andamento ou concluído, com foco em Compliance, Gestão de Riscos, Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro, Auditoria e/ou Gestão de Pessoas.

Title : Director - Regional CMC

Location : Brazil, Remote

Experience : Min 15 years in Regulatory Affairs, CMC

Director – Regional CMC

Objective:

The Director – Regional CMC will manage the Regional CMC team, ensuring seamless integration between global Regulatory CMC strategies and local affiliate execution. This role is pivotal in driving regional alignment, efficiency, and consistency in post-approval submissions across a diverse product portfolio, including small molecules, biologics, vaccines, and plasma-derived therapies. The Director – Regional CMC will champion the development and implementation of regional strategies, fostering collaboration and process improvement to meet regulatory requirements effectively and efficiently.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage the Regional CMC team, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure high performance and professional development.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, promoting knowledge sharing and best practices.
  • Develop and execute a strategic vision for the Regional CMC Liaison function, aligning with global Regulatory CMC objectives.
  • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary skills, knowledge, and resources to excel in their roles.
  • Translate global CMC strategies into comprehensive regional plans, ensuring alignment with country-specific regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of regional submission strategies to streamline processes and reduce duplication of effort.
  • Partner with global and regional stakeholders to identify opportunities for harmonization and efficiency.
  • Monitor and report on submission timelines and regulatory approvals, addressing any issues or delays proactively.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local affiliates to understand and address country-specific regulatory needs and challenges.
  • Liaise with global Regulatory CMC teams to provide regional insights and feedback, ensuring a cohesive approach to regulatory submissions.
  • Represent the Regional CMC Liaison function in cross-functional and global meetings, advocating for regional needs and perspectives.
  • Identify and address bottlenecks in the regional submission process, proposing and implementing innovative solutions to enhance efficiency.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging best practices and lessons learned to optimize regional submission processes.
  • Ensure compliance with regional and country-specific regulatory requirements and guidelines.

Education & Competencies (Technical and Behavioral):

  • BS/BA Degree in a Scientific Discipline, Advanced Degree (M.S), with Ph.D. preferred.
  • 15+ years of seasoned biopharmaceutical/device industry experience or with a regulatory agency is preferred, while leading major submissions during LCM, development - including preparation of NDA/NLA/MAA.
  • Equivalent industry experience with direct technical/product development experience such as Pharmaceutical Development, Analytical Development, Production, Quality Assurance can be considered.
  • People leadership experience (5+ years) required.
  • Highly proficient understanding of scientific principles and profound grasp of global regulatory CMC requirements relevant to global drug development and post-market support.
  • Keeping abreast of industry insights and regulatory trends to drive organizational evolution.
  • Proven ability to understand and communicate regulatory strategy to drug development, registration, and post-market support teams.
  • Analyze issues with attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess and scientifically justify alternative approaches.
  • Base regulatory strategy recommendations on precedents and other regulatory intelligence as well as regulations and guidelines.
  • Able to deal with issues of critical importance independently.
  • Exercises excellent judgment in elevating and communicating actual or potential issues to line management.
  • Understands who is responsible for different decisions, drives and escalates as necessary.
  • Implements the directions taken by the company, leading with agility through evolving landscapes.
  • Intentionally promotes an inclusive culture, leveraging individual strengths for team success.
  • Develops and drives prioritization framework, managing shifting priorities and tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional skills in written and oral communication.
  • Demonstrates excellent skills in leadership, collaboration, negotiation, problem solving, and fostering interpersonal connections through teamwork.

description:
Cientista de Dados Pleno

O Chaves na Mão é um dos principais portais de classificados de imóveis e veículos do Brasil. Nossa missão é conectar usuários a oportunidades reais, proporcionando uma experiência fluida, intuitiva e de alta performance.

A missão do Cientista de Dados é desenvolver e evoluir modelos de machine learning que gerem impacto direto no produto, no negócio e na experiência dos usuários. Você será responsável por transformar dados em inteligência de mercado, criando algoritmos, análises e soluções que melhorem conversão, previsão, personalização e tomada de decisão.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar, treinar e manter modelos de machine learning (supervisionados e não supervisionados).
  • Desenvolver modelos de recomendação, lead scoring, previsão e segmentação.
  • Construir pipelines completos (ingestão → preparação → treino → deploy → monitoramento).
  • Implementar processos de MLOps para colocar modelos em produção e acompanhar sua performance.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para identificar problemas e oportunidades.
  • Realizar análises exploratórias, estudos estatísticos, testes e experimentações para validar hipóteses.
  • Transformar grandes volumes de dados estruturados e não estruturados em insights acionáveis.
  • Garantir documentação, versionamento, qualidade e reprodutibilidade dos modelos.
  • Criar métricas de avaliação, monitoramento e indicadores de impacto.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Matemática ou áreas correlatas;

title: HR Sr. Supervisor
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a Talent & Culture professional to plan, coordinate, and execute key People & Culture processes across multiple corporate functions, including Sales, Finance, IT, Legal, HR, Marketing, and Customer Experience. This role will play a critical part in talent attraction, learning and development, employee engagement, DEI initiatives, community involvement, and integration support during acquisitions, while maintaining accurate reporting to enable data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the talent attraction strategy aligned with business objectives.
  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for administrative and professional roles.
  • Execute the annual training plan.
  • Coordinate mandatory, technical, and development trainings, including onboarding programs.
  • Ensure performance management cycles are completed on time, guiding leaders and employees on processes and timelines.
  • Implement programs that foster communication, motivation, participation, recognition, and engagement, aligned with regional strategies.
  • Coordinate employee surveys (local, regional, and global), analyze results, and support leaders in defining action plans to improve the employee experience.
  • Drive organizational culture initiatives aligned with the regional Talent & Culture strategy.
  • Manage local internal communications aligned with regional and global strategies.
  • Promote DEI and community engagement initiatives, ensuring fair practices, respectful work environments, and equal access to development and safety opportunities, aligned with the regional DEI & Wellbeing strategy.
  • Consolidate and maintain HR data and key indicators (time-to-fill, training completion, participation in initiatives, etc.) according to the role’s scorecard.
  • Develop and update HR policies and procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with labor regulations and corporate guidelines.
  • Set clear goals, monitor performance, and provide continuous feedback to support professional growth.
  • Provide coaching to supervisors on performance management, disciplinary processes, engagement, communication, turnover, and team management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in Human Resources or People & Culture roles.
  • Full-cycle recruitment processes (competency-based).
  • Interviewing and talent assessment techniques.
  • Training and talent development methodologies.

title: Inside Sales Specialist
description:
Our future is yours!

Who are we?

We are Bridge Polymers, an international company with multiple branches across Europe and

beyond. We trade in polyolefins - something you’ve probably never heard of, yet encounter

every day. These are types of plastic with hundreds of different applications. Our customers use

these plastic pellets to create their products. Our suppliers are global producers of

petrochemicals, and we focus primarily on trading polyethylene and polypropylene.

Bridge Polymers has offices in several countries, including Spain, Poland, Romania, Brazil and

more, with our headquarters based in Eindhoven, the Netherlands. The market we operate in is

fast-paced. Thanks to our straightforward, honest, and down-to-earth company culture, we can

perform at our best even in the hectic world of fast trading. We are flexible and work with short

lines of communication, allowing us to always stay on top of the business!

Your responsibilities

Working at Bridge Polymers means working on your own future within a dynamic company. This

is especially true for the Inside Sales Specialist we are currently seeking. How your journey

unfolds and where you ultimately end up is largely in your own hands.

As an Inside Sales Specialist, you will receive a structured onboarding and development

program designed to help you quickly gain confidence in your role. From day one, you will be

actively contributing while deepening your knowledge in the following areas:

Business Development & Prospection

● Research new markets and identify potential commercial opportunities.

● Analyse import statistics and market data to uncover new prospects.

● Proactively engage with potential customers through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.

● Set up daily meetings with prospects to explore potential collaborations.

● Contact customers to understand their product requirements and gather relevant market

intelligence.

Sales Support

● Prepare, create, and send offers and proformas.

● Manage follow-ups to support the full sales cycle from lead to deal.

● Assist in applying for credit limits and monitoring customer credit status.

● Follow up on payments, required documentation, and overall deal progress.

Customer Administration

● Handle day-to-day communication with prospects and clients.

● Ensure all customer data, requests, and feedback are accurately documented and

managed.

● Support the sales team by maintaining a smooth and organized administrative workflow.

In short: an excellent career outlook - and it’s up to you to fulfil your potential.

Requirements

● You have a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, International trade or similar field.

● You have at least 1–2 years of experience in a sales or business development role.

● Knowledge of import/export processes and B2B sales is a strong advantage.

● You are independent, ambitious, commercially minded, proactive, and able to perform

under pressure.

● You are fluent in spoken and written English and Portuguese.

● You are able to travel to Blumenau 2 or 3 days a week.

What we offer

● Excellent employment conditions.

● Salary progression linked to your personal growth and performance.

● Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

● The opportunity to be part of a dynamic, international team.

description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Assegurar a gestão de equipe sob sua responsabilidade.

title: Portuguese Language and Literature Teacher, Upper Grades
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

WHAT YOU'LL DO

At Avenues, Portuguese language and literature courses are interdisciplinary. History topics are closely interwoven with literature studied in Portuguese, growing in depth and complexity, with extensive collaboration with other disciplines including Science, Art, and World Course. Classes are discussion-based, promoting inquiry, exploration, and presentation. We expect students to write well and frequently, and engage in independent project work. You will also:

  • Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs
  • Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous but joyful learning community
  • Collaborate intensively with colleagues to design interdisciplinary projects and continually deepen student learning
  • Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families

Qualifications

Portuguese teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

  • As a requirement, candidates applying for this role must have a Brazilian Teaching Degree in Portuguese (Licenciatura em Letras, com habilitação em Português)
  • Experience teaching Portuguese & Literature for high school students, with clear evidence of student learning and growth
  • Deep knowledge of, and an infectious passion for, literature and the tools of literary analysis
  • English proficiency to engage in meaningful professional collaboration with English-speaking colleagues
  • A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition
  • Passion for working with young people as they learn, struggle, and grow
  • Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice
  • Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work
  • A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

title: Coordenador de eventos
description:
Vaga: Coordenador de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos

Sobre a Welcome:

Somos uma empresa de assessoria em viagens com o propósito de criar experiências e transformar pessoas. Nossa atuação é dividida em três frentes especializadas: Welcome Weddings , setor especializado em Destination Wedding, com assessoria completa e personalizada desde a da produção do casamento até a viagem. A Welcome Trips que é o setor especializado em viagens de lazer, onde a personalização e a excelência são a essência de cada roteiro, e Welcome Corp, focada em viagens corporativas e de incentivo.

A Welcome Weddings é reconhecida internacionalmente como a melhor produtora de Destination Wedding da América Latina. Mais do que realizar casamentos, nossa missão é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Os setores de Planejamento e Produção de Eventos são responsáveis por conceber, organizar e coordenar todos os detalhes de um Destination Wedding, desde a escolha do destino e do local ideais até a execução impecável de cada evento. A equipe compreende profundamente o perfil e os desejos do casal, orienta nas decisões mais adequadas, realiza a reserva da data, o bloqueio de apartamentos no hotel definido e estrutura toda a programação dos eventos. Além disso, conecta o casal aos profissionais ideais e garante que cada elemento reflita sua visão, proporcionando uma experiência única, personalizada e memorável.

Sua missão:

Sua missão será liderar, integrar e garantir a excelência de todo o processo do Destination Wedding , atuando da concepção à entrega final para garantir o propósito da Welcome Weddings que é realizar o melhor dia da vida do casal.

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a operação completa dos eventos;
  • Liderar e orientar as equipes;
  • Supervisionar a escolha dos destinos e locais;
  • Acompanhar e validar reservas e bloqueios;
  • Garantir a estruturação da programação dos eventos;
  • Assegurar a personalização e a qualidade da entrega;
  • Monitorar a experiência do casal do início ao fim.

Suas principais atividades:

Acompanhar a jornada de cada casal com base nos processos de Planejamento e Produção, garantindo alinhamento, qualidade e personalização em todas as etapas. Estruturar, aprimorar e monitorar continuamente os processos de Planejamento e Produção junto à Wedding Planner responsável por cada projeto. Apoiar as demandas operacionais dos departamentos, definindo a Wedding Planner responsável por cada casal em cada fase do processo. Conduzir reuniões estratégicas semanais com os departamentos, promovendo alinhamento e tomada de decisão. Desenvolver e capacitar os times, apoiando o Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI) de cada colaborador. Atuar como elo entre coordenadores e diretoria, assegurando comunicação clara e estratégica. Prevenir e gerenciar situações de crise, garantindo soluções rápidas, eficazes e alinhadas aos valores da empresa. Acompanhar metas e indicadores de desempenho de cada setor, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções. Gerir o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos e representar a Welcome em eventos institucionais e do mercado de eventos.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Custos e Orçamento de Nuvem (FinOps)

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. DIFERENCIAL

title: GenAI Solution Architect
description:
GenAI Solution Architect

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Full Time

In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.

Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.

Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.

Soft Skills and Others:

  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

description:
Qual desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Instrutor(a) Operações Agrícolas para atuar no time de Operações Agrícolas.

Quais as responsabilidades?

Atuar de forma especializada nas operações: Preparo de solo, plantio mecanizado e tratos culturais de cana-de-açúcar;

Disseminar melhores padrões de operação, através de treinamento/desenvolvimento constante, em campo e sala, de operadores/motoristas;

Monitorar indicadores de performance do operador, como consumo de combustível, velocidade/rotação de motor, rendimento, qualidade de operação, etc;

Mapear e registrar pontos críticos, propondo soluções com olhar de melhoria contínua;

Apoiar a implementação de novos projetos, como implantação de novas tecnologias;

Realizar avaliação técnica de candidatos às posições de operadores/motoristas;

Quais os requisitos?

Ensino médio completo e desejável formação técnica;

Conhecimento em pacote office e tecnologia embarcada (GPS e Solinfitec);

Experiência com desenvolvimento técnico de operadores;

Conhecimento básico em mecânica/elétrica de veículos;

CNH E;

Disponibilidade para turnos e residir em Olímpia/SP.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.

Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.

Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.

Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.

Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the "procure-to-pay" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities

What we’re looking for:

title: Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor
description:
Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page HERE !

Job Overview:

The Security & Loss Prevention Supervisor is responsible for leading the implementation of security services and asset protection across all logistics activities, including transportation, warehouses, and hubs. This role oversees the Security & Loss Prevention department, conducting audits and investigations to minimize potential losses for the organization. Coordinates responses to on-road incidents such as thefts, pilferages, and accidents, and evaluates vendors to identify vulnerabilities and propose mitigation strategies. As a key member of the logistics team, they collaborate with operational teams, internal departments like Legal and Finance, as well as external security authorities. Additionally, they work with internal and external stakeholders to continuously improve existing solutions, explore new approaches, conduct industry benchmarking, and track established metrics for loss prevention.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Be aware of the goals and direction of the Company and align all decisions and activities to support that direction and achieve the goals, which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements.
  • Lead investigations of internal and external occurrences, some cases involving police department in all states.
  • Serve as department’s liaison and security matter expert.
  • Develop business cases which receive the required approval, financial and technical resources, and the support of appropriate management to enact desired changes
  • Drive process improvements and increase efficiency by apply innovation initiatives (AI, drones, new technologies, etc.).
  • Designing and implementing the security and loss prevention strategy, standards and procedures.
  • Driving internal and external (vendors) audits to ensure that losses are kept at a minimal level.
  • Designing security procedures for all logistics processes, mainly for transportation and warehouses.
  • Effectively address security incidents. Detecting and addressing any discrepancies/pilferage for key metrics.
  • Participate in projects like warehouse layout (placement or cameras, security system, etc) and transportation monitoring center software as examples.
  • Background & Experience
  • A completed Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university
  • Prior experience in law enforcement, asset protection, audit, risk management or other related security field
  • Familiarity with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, alarms, and CCTVs;
  • Results oriented leader that possesses strong influencing skill and is comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment while prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities;
  • Analytical leader experienced in performance based, action and results oriented management, and effective problem-solver;
  • Ability to take calculated risks and challenge current practices to develop and deliver innovative solutions to meet or exceed the customer expectations.
  • English level intermediate is mandatory.

Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

title: Talent Acquisition Operations Lead
description:

As the Talent Acquisition Operations Lead in a fast-growing business, you will build the recruiting operations foundation—from interviewer capability and hiring processes, to systems, data, and candidate experience.   • Scale Interview & Hiring Capability： Train and level-up interviewers and hiring managers, define a clear hiring bar, and build simple tools (playbooks, guides, templates) that make great interviewing easy and consistent.

  • Own Recruiting Tech： Lead ATS setup and optimization, integrate key tools, and drive strong adoption so systems actually make hiring faster.
  • Elevate Candidate Experience: Design an end-to-end candidate journey that’s smooth, transparent, and reflective of our culture; collect feedback and iterate quickly.
  • Partner & Lead: Be a strategic partner to TA and business leaders, collaborate cross-functionally, and lead a lean, high-impact ops team as we scale.

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years in TA or HR, with hands-on experience in TA operations.
  • Proven experience building or improving recruiting processes, interviewer enablement, and candidate experience.
  • Strong ATS ownership experience—implementation or deep optimization in a startup or fast-growth environment preferred.
  • Data-driven mindset: skilled at funnel metrics, reporting, and insights.
  • Ability to balance strategy with execution—comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration.

Preferred

  • Experience in multi-country expansion is a plus.
  • Background in technology or internet industry environments.

Why This Role is Exciting

  • Shape TA foundation from zero-to-one
  • Drive both vision and hands-on execution
  • Work directly with leadership
  • Build scalable systems and processes that influence long-term talent strategy

title: Bolsista Doutor - Superbac - PDI em Inteligência de Mercado | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências , e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável .

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A transformação digital é um dos pilares da nova economia, e você pode ser protagonista desse movimento. Estamos desenvolvendo uma plataforma inovadora de apoio à decisão empresarial, baseada em técnicas de aprendizado de máquina (Machine Learning – ML), com o objetivo de integrar dados operacionais e de mercado para prever a demanda de produtos, otimizar a cadeia de suprimentos e antecipar tendências setoriais.

Essa é uma iniciativa estratégica que une ciência de dados, inteligência artificial e visão de negócios, promovendo maior eficiência e competitividade no mercado global. Se você tem perfil analítico, gosta de transformar dados em soluções práticas e deseja atuar em projetos de impacto, essa oportunidade é para você!

Formação Acadêmica:

Graduação em Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Produção, Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Ciência de Dados

Doutorado em metodologias de computação, matemática aplicada, estatística, bioestatística, gestão de operações, ciência de dados, inteligência artificial, controle de processos industriais ou áreas afins com foco em modelagem matemática e aprendizado de máquina.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Projeto: PDI em Inteligência de Mercado: Previsão, segmentação e otimização de operações e estratégias comerciais por meio de Machine Learning

  • Integração dos Modelos à Plataforma de Inteligência Artificial
  • Validação Piloto, Ajustes Finais e Escalabilidade

Especialização ou cursos em:

  • Scikit-learn
  • Caret
  • Tidyverse
  • (ou similares)

Conhecimento desejável:

  • Construção e validação de modelos preditivos
  • Integração de diferentes fontes de dados
  • Gestão e governança de dados (preparação, curadoria e uso de dados para treinamento e validação de modelos)
  • Comunicação de conceitos técnicos de forma clara para equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo equipes técnicas e gestores empresariais

title: Finance Senior Analyst
description:
About MGI

In April 2024, MGI Tech opened a Customer Experience Center in Brazil to contribute to the advancement of genomics in Latin America. The goal is to provide a facility for clinical and research laboratories, hospitals, and universities to enhance learning and experience with genetic sequencing technology, applied in precision medicine, oncology, Agri genomics (the application of genomics in agriculture), and metagenomics (the study of environmental microbial communities), among other segments. MGI Brazil is committed to enabling effective and affordable healthcare solutions for all. Based on its proprietary technology, MGI produces sequencing devices, equipment, consumables, and reagents to support life science research, medicine, and healthcare. MGI is recognized globally as an innovator and for conducting international collaborative projects with leading research institutions for the betterment of mankind and the world in which we live. MGI values its employees, as we believe they are the driving force behind our success and commercial expansion globally.

POSITION PROFILE

MGI is seeking an in-country finance professional to play an important role in the expansion of business operations in Brazil. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China.

Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Operation:

  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities.
  • Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions.
  • Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures.
  • Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform)

Month-end Closing and Reporting:

  • Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil.
  • Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team.
  • Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures.

Tax Compliance and annual audit support:

  • Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations.
  • Support group annual audit procedures (i.e. audit confirmations and PBC list)

Cash Management:

  • Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations.
  • Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US.

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions.

Commercial Team Support:

  • Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team.
  • Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards.
  • Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.)
  • BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus.
  • Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus.
  • Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus.
  • Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus.
  • Must have strong excel skills.

BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE

  • Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to proactively identify and solve problems.
  • Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision.
  • Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities.
  • Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.

API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.

Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.

Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento Humano
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como responsável pelo acompanhamento dos colaboradores alocados nos clientes Dexian. O acompanhamento será remoto/presencial e através da plataforma DexianConnect.
  • Realizar e conduzir o processo de Onborading, inclusive atualizando a apresentação, conforme mudanças ocorram na empresa.
  • Acompanhar processos administrativos dos profissionais alocados (esclarecimento dúvidas sobre rotinas de RH, fechamento de ponto, férias, alinhamento de horários, orientações diversas, etc).
  • Acompanhar o processo de Desenvolvimento (avaliação do período de experiência, alinhamento de performance, resultado das pesquisas de engajamento por cliente, pontos de oportunidades, PDI´s, feedbacks, reuniões 1:1, realocação de profissionais).
  • Fazer a interface com os gestores demandantes de vagas nos clientes para monitoramento de satisfação com os profissionais.
  • Estar em interação com as áreas de negócio da Dexian (Comercial, DP e R&S para que estejam sempre atualizados das informações levantadas sobre os colaboradores nos clientes).
  • Elaborar e manter atualizado mensalmente o Radar de Monitoramento de consultores e envio por e-mail para equipe comercial.
  • Conduz o processo de de off-boarding dos consultores.
  • Elaboração de políticas da área de DH.
  • Atuar na plataforma DexianConnect junto aos consultores para engajamento nas ações de celebração, acompanhamento dos comunicados, pesquisas, registros de 1:1, monitoramento da realização do Onboarding e realização da Avaliação do Período de Experiência (autoavaliação do consultor) dentro do prazo e PDI´s.

O que você precisa ter

  • Formação superior completa Psicologia, Gestão em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas afins.
  • Desejável Pós-graduação em RH.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação híbrida e para realizar visitas em clientes.
  • Ter bom domínio Pacote Office.
  • Desejável inglês em nível intermediário/avançado .

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Demonstrar vontade de aprender e conhecer.
  • Ter boa adaptação e flexibilidade, uma vez que irá atuar com diversos clientes e perfis.
  • Ser ágil, dinâmico e proativo.
  • Apresentar resiliência para lidar com imprevistos e mudanças.
  • Ter capacidade de análise de dados e proposição de melhorias e planos de ação.
  • Capacidade, maturidade e autonomia para tomar decisões dentro do seu escopo de atuação.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. São Paulo - SP - Regime Híbrido

Regime de Contratação: CLT

Benefícios para você

* Vale Refeição

* Vale Alimentação

* Assistência Médica

* Assistência Odontológica

* Seguro de Vida

* Gym Pass

* Auxílio Pet

Além disso, oferecemos :

* Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian

* Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

title: Senior Murex Integration Specialist (S4C)
description:
Project Description:

Luxoft has one of the world's leading Murex practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.

Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.

Responsibilities:

- Must know the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart

- Knowledge and hands on experience in implementing, developing and supporting various MX.3 proprietary modules for Enterprise Integration such as MxML Exchange, Datamart, MX.3 Accessibility and Extensibility APIs (.Net, Java, C++, and SOAP/REST Web services), Real-time bridging service, Market Data Cache Server, MX.3 Connectivity 2.0 framework, MX.3 Packaged interfaces including (but not limited to) MarkitWire, DTCC Global Trade Repository, MarginSphere, IceLink, FXAll, Market Data Import Tool etc., MX.3 End of Day processes and Trade Life Cycle Management using workflows engine. (At least 3 years)

- Build new up / down stream integration(s)

- Convert existing integration point with Murex version change

- Development of MxML (Workflows, Exchange)

- XSL / Transformation

- Scripting (bsh, ksh, ...etc.)

- Assist existing support group(s) in resolving integration related request or issues

- Contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

- Liaise with technical team(s) -- when needed -- to resolve environment related issues and necessary enhancements in preparation for cloud deployment

- Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per project deliverables

- Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

1. Provide professional services to Murex clients:

o Provide services in the domain of system integration, business intelligence and data flows through the full lifecycle of the MX.3: requirements analysis, configuration build, installation, training, upgrade, and production support.

o Professionally interact with Murex colleagues and clients.

2. Build, test, and provide support to clients on MX.3 integration modules.

o Contribute to project implementations

 Participate in design, build, and test phases sometimes remotely and other times at the client site as needed.

 Develop trade workflows and interfaces to set up communication between external platforms and murex to receive trade and other data feeds, process them, save into the system, and send acknowledgement. Use a combination of MXMLExchange, MXopenconnect, Murex APIs, and Datamart to successfully deliver such solutions.

 Contribute to functional documentation of the test cases and use cases by the client.

 Contribute to Design documentation for the Build process of the Product.

 Develop and maintain end-to-end configuration management packages etc. Install, Deploy and test Murex packaged interfaces like MDIT (market data interface tool), Markitwire, BSMT and MarkitCredit to receive live and end-of-day data from external providers like Bloomberg, Reuters, Markit, etc.

o Handle support cases from notification to resolution and validation.

• Participate in the business as usual and project support: follow-up of client open cases through email, CRM portal, phone-calls and on-site visits

• Develop an understanding of ongoing activities and manage own deliverables / progress

• Manage bug fixes and enhancements with the Product Team

3. Integrate with various teams to deliver the right solution to client.

o Work with S4C stream leads, Front-Office, Back-Office, or Risk teams to understand requirements and develop solutions for the client.

o Work with the Product division team to provide them timely details on defects - how to reproduce the issue, project/client constraints, and how to validate the fix.

o Follow up with the S4C stream leads, the Project Manager, and other teams to meet deadlines and regular meetings to make sure the delivery is on time.

4. Work with technologies including SQL, Unix, and Murex proprietary standards like Murex Scripting Language (MSL), XMLF, etc. for client solutions.

o Use SQL for end-of-day report generation, STP (straight through processing) failure issues, P&L evaluation, for analyzing issues in trade feed and status Etc.

o Java programming skills are not essential but are a plus.

o Various Murex proprietary languages and formats: Data Query Language for querying in various screens in MX.3, MSL (Murex Scripting Language) for pre-trade logic, XMLF for post-trade flow processing, MxML in various contexts, etc.

o Create shell/python scripts for automation of day-to-day manual activities.

Understand requirements, analyze the problem areas of the current system and behavior of pre- trade and post-trade workflow, and integration points.

Mandatory Skills Description:

Must:

- 4+ years experience with Murex Datamart and workflows

- Must know any 2 of the following technologies: MxMLExchange, RTBS/MDCS, Datamart, C2.0 Product interfaces

- SQL; XML; MxML; UNIX; Scripting languages

- Hands on experience with Murex MxML Exchange development

- Knowledge of pre trade framework along with MSL scripting language

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Knowledge of XML/JSON and related technologies (XSLT), Java/J2EE, Python, or C/C++ or C#, and scripting languages such as UNIX Shell or JavaScript, Jenkins, CI/CD, DevOps, Maven, Git/Bitbucket, Apache Camel, ESB, ETL

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills

- Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter

- Possess good verbal and written communication skills

- Must have strong organization skills

- Previous Experience in Murex Integration (MxML/WF) experience

- Strong Knowledge of SQL/RDBMS technology

- Familiarity with UNIX/Linux operating systems

- Strong DataMart Murex knowledge is a must

- Rigorous attention to detail

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

- Understanding of Test management

- Understanding of Trade life cycle

- Understanding of Market Data management

- Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.

- Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.

- Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.

- Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.

- Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.

- Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions.

Languages:

English: C2 Proficient

Samsung is looking for a proactive, detailed-oriented candidate with a great sense of ownership to join our team located in São Paulo.

Treasury Specialist will provide support in supervising and overseeing treasury operations of Latin America subsidiaries. The special part of this position is that this role will be very dynamic. Requirements
